description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Terror the Peaks.
When the Terror of the Peaks tokens enter, the nontoken Terror of the Peaks triggers five times, and each Terror of the Peaks token triggers four times.
Resolve all Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 125 damage divided among a maximum of 25 targets.
